variant: Check icon marks the current scope and fields choice; defaults are scope 'list' and fields 'both'
purpose: Chooses what the search covers.
text: 'This list' (scope:list), 'Whole project' (scope:project), 'All projects' (scope:all), divider, 'Title & notes' (fields:both), 'Title only' (fields:title), 'Notes only' (fields:notes)
behaviour: Clicking an item sets scope or fields on the pane's search state.

variant: Single-row items: 'Copy' (content_copy); 'Add subtask' (subdirectory_arrow_right, divider above); 'Rename' (edit); 'Move to list' (arrow_forward, disabled when no other lists, submenu of list names with id move:{listId}); 'Promote to top level' (north_west, only when the task has parent_id); 'Delete task…' (delete, danger, divider above). Multi-row variant (2 or more selected and this row is in the selection): 'Copy {n} tasks' (content_copy); 'Mark {n} done' (task_alt, divider above); 'Mark {n} not done' (radio_button_unchecked); 'Move to list' (arrow_forward, submenu); 'Delete {n} tasks…' (delete, danger, divider above).
purpose: Row actions, from right-click or the More button.
behaviour: Each item runs its action: copy to clipboard, mark done or undone, add subtask (sets the inline composer), rename (beginTitleEdit), promote, delete (requestDeleteTask or bulkDelete), or move.

behaviour: appears on focus and disappears on blur; repositions on scroll or resize

variant: Rename… (icon drive_file_rename_outline); Open (icon open_in_new); Reveal in Finder (icon folder_open, local only); Remove (icon delete, danger, dividerAbove)
purpose: Actions on one attachment.
text: Rename… | Open | Reveal in Finder | Remove
behaviour: Rename… runs renameAttachment (askText 'Rename attachment', then api.renameAttachment and propagateAttachmentRename). Open runs api.openAttachment. Reveal in Finder runs api.revealAttachment. Remove runs removeAttachment (askConfirm 'Remove attachment?', then api.deleteAttachment).

variant: Command row with a keyboard hint. Props: data-idx=i, active, onMouseMove, onClick, leading=Icon, trailing=HotkeyHint.
purpose: One runnable command with a keyboard shortcut. Click or Enter runs it and closes the palette.
text: Command labels in palette state: "Toggle preview", "Toggle split view", "Show / hide completed", "Collapse all", "Expand all", "New task", "Search this list", "Undo", "Redo", "New list", "New project", "Settings". Labels in palette-search: "New task", "New list", "New project".
states: active (highlighted; idx 0 at open, and any row under the pointer or reached by arrow keys)
hover (mouse move sets active to this row)
behaviour: Click calls runAt(i), which closes the palette and then runs cmd.run(). Mouse move sets active to i. Enter on the active row runs it the same way.
